summary: M2.S3.5 (D-026) bidirectional Property<->Client link fully tested. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed covering /clients/sellers (filter, regex, auth), POST/PATCH properties with seller_client_id (set, change, null-with-exclude_unset semantics), and /clients/{cid}/properties (linked-only, 404 for unknown cid, multi-tenant, empty for buyer). Frontend UI verified: SellerPicker green-card + open-card/cambia/rimuovi actions, debounced (250ms) search returning seller-opt-{id} items, owner-snapshot autofill, persistence after save+reopen, Carried-properties section visible for seller/landlord only, hidden for buyer.

issues: Each carried-prop item is a <li> with onClick=window.open(...) instead of a real <a target=_blank>. Visually correct and opens new tab, but lacks anchor semantics (no href, no middle-click/right-click support, no keyboard activation, missing role='link'). Consider wrapping the <li> content in an <a> for accessibility and link affordances.
Console warning: '`value` prop on input should not be null' — already noted in iteration_1, still present. Coerce nulls to '' when hydrating SearchPreferences fields.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Wrap each carried-prop <li> content in an <a href=`/${lang}/app/properties/${p.id}` target='_blank' rel='noreferrer'> for better accessibility and link semantics (instead of onClick+window.open).
OPTIONAL: Fix the lingering null-value React warning in ClientFormPage SearchPreferences hydration (carry-over from iteration_1).

DOC: The PATCH /api/app/properties behavior is: sending seller_client_id=null keeps the previous value (exclude_unset + 'skip None' loop). This is correct PATCH semantics, but means the only way to clear a seller link via API is to send an empty-string or via a dedicated unlink endpoint. The frontend currently does not exercise 'set null' through PATCH because Rimuovi only changes local state until next save (and saving then sends a payload that still includes other fields with seller_client_id=null which is ignored). If product requirement is 'Rimuovi must clear seller on save', a small backend change is needed (e.g. allow seller_client_id=None to $unset the field).
critical_code_review_comments: properties.py:175-181 — 'if v is None: continue' loop swallows any explicit-null PATCH. Combined with PropertyUpdate having all Optional[...] fields, this prevents API-level field clearing. Acceptable PATCH semantics, but if 'Rimuovi seller' must persist, the seller_client_id needs special handling (e.g. use exclude_none=False for selected fields or a $unset path).

clients.py:147-168 — GET /clients/{cid}/properties correctly enforces tenant (agency_id) and excludes _id; cover_photo_url derived from photos[].is_cover OR first photo. Limit 200 hardcoded — fine for MVP; consider pagination if portfolios grow.

PropertyFormPage.jsx SellerPicker — debounce + autoload on focus is correct; hydration useEffect avoids refetch when picked.id matches value. Owner snapshot autofill (name/phone/email) happens only when an option is selected (via the onChange callback in parent); confirmed by code review of parent invocation.
ClientFormPage.jsx:260-295 — carried-prop uses non-semantic <li> with onClick=window.open. Functional but a11y/regression concern (see frontend_issues).

rca of the issue: No bugs blocking the mini-sprint. The only nuance worth highlighting is PATCH null-vs-omit semantics on properties.update: both null and omitted are treated identically (no-op). If 'Rimuovi → Save' must really unlink the seller in DB, a backend change is required.
